The experience buffer implements an island-based evolutionary model inspired by FunSearch, allowing exploration of diverse hypotheses while maintaining convergence guarantees. Each island maintains a history of successful skeletons and scores, guiding future sampling via Boltzmann selection over scores and normalized program lengths.
